name: std::chrono::weekday::ok
intro: Checks if the weekday value stored in *this is in the valid range, i.e., [0, 6].

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: true if the weekday value stored in *this is in the range [0, 6]. Otherwise false.

examples.output:
u: 0; wd: 0 (is valid weekday)
u: 1; wd: 1 (is valid weekday)
u: 6; wd: 6 (is valid weekday)
u: 7; wd: 0 (is valid weekday)
u: 8; wd: 8 (is not valid weekday)
u: 9; wd: 9 (is not valid weekday)

summary: Checks if the weekday value stored in *this is in the valid range, i.e., [0, 6].
